items.title: Google Cloud races to catch up in the AI deployment wars with Accenture deal
items.feed_excerpt: Google Cloud expands its enterprise AI push with Accenture, betting on forward-deployed engineers to drive adoption and overcome deployment bottlenecks.

items.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
items.feed_excerpt: Meta's new personal AI agent Muse wants access to users' email, calendars, payments, health services, and more — making the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet a major test of whether people still trust Meta with their data.
